commit.message:
feat(forge): omp extension names the acting agent and gates frozen paths (F1, F7)

Every capability call carries CRATYLUS_AGENT (launched declaration, dispatched
agent, else none; ambient value dropped). A write/edit/ast_edit of a frozen
path, or a bash/eval naming one or naming CRATYLUS_AGENT, is refused before it
takes effect unless the acting agent is the cut's architect. Capability
refusals return as tool errors.
